column5: Personally re-audited despite inherited @early-stop. Base/retail have identical 123 instructions, 11 calls, 25 relocs and all semantic operations/member stores. Retail allocates constant 1 to EBX and 0 to EBP; base allocates 0 to EBX and 1 to EBP, making the RegisterLogicTypesOnce assignment require a duplicated arm plus one jump (3 vs 2 branches, 0x1b0 vs 0x1ab). Existing CWapX Hide alone and ApplyName+Hide helper boundaries were compiled and byte-flat. Source spelling is bounded regalloc-induced tail merging, not missing CFG.

Retained six proven CellFlagsAt folds: body 0xb88->0xb80 and branch-normalized exact alignment 227->236/871 with calls 25, branches 131, relocs 64 unchanged. Rejected header-inline Push at all eight sites (zero retail Push calls; RemoveHead stayed 3/4), block-local pooled variables (byte-identical), reProbe-only whole-splice inline wrapper (0xb68/872 but branches worsened 127), and explicit branch returns at both late tails (byte-identical 0xb80/876/131). Next recover an original helper boundary or control-flow source distinction that prevents initial/reProbe splice folding.
